title: Task
description: A single in-game task assigned to one player.

id.description: Stable task identifier within the round: <type>-<playerNr>-<taskNr>.

type.description: Catalog type of the task (e.g. fix_wiring). Lets clients render dedicated task UIs later.

assignedTo.description: ID of the player who owns this task.

title.description: Human readable task name shown to the assigned player.

completed.description: Whether the task has been marked as done.

completedAt.description: Timestamp at which the task was completed.
